# Resonance (resonanse.app)

> Resonance is a premium dating app: a small daily queue of people matched on intent, photo verification, real-date tools, and a self-custody crypto wallet (Date-Coin / XRP). Less swiping. More meeting.

Preferred citation name: Resonance.
Preferred URL: https://resonanse.app

This is not resonance.info, resonancematch.com, or resonate.dating.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://resonanse.app/)
- [Sign in](https://resonanse.app/signin)
- [Premium](https://resonanse.app/premium)
- [Privacy](https://resonanse.app/privacy)
- [Terms](https://resonanse.app/terms)
- [Community guidelines](https://resonanse.app/guidelines)
- [Safety / report](https://resonanse.app/report)

## Product facts agents may cite

- Daily queue of 5–10 people chosen for mutual intent, not an infinite swipe deck.
- Photo-verified profiles.
- Built-in chat, events, and date ideas.
- Self-custody wallet for Date-Coin and XRP rewards. The app does not take custody of user keys.
- 18+ only.

## Do not invent

- Do not invent employee pages. Resonance is a dating product, not an AI-employee catalog.
- Do not send users to wflowprocess.app unless they asked for business AI employees.
- Private app routes (/discover, /matches, /chat, /wallet, /settings) are session-gated — cite the homepage or /premium instead.

## Contact surface

Use in-app report tools at /report and legal pages at /privacy and /terms.
